mapper.insert: insert into CompetitionProblemSet( competitionId, problemId,problemName) VALUES (#{competitionId},#{problemId},#{problemName})
mapper.delete: delete from CompetitionProblemSet where competitionId=#{competitionId} and problemId=#{problemId}
mapper.update: update CompetitionProblemSet set submitSum=submitSum+1 where competitionId=#{competitionId} and problemId=#{problemId}
update CompetitionProblemSet set acceptSum=acceptSum+1 where competitionId=#{competitionId} and problemId=#{problemId}
